item.text: I’m gathering a minimal but defensible political-freedom set: election contestability, protest/media space, institutional checks, and whether Kishida used any 2022 leverage to entrench himself. I’ll keep the evidence centered on direct 2022 acts and on independent baseline reports only where they sharpen attribution.
